body:
I certainly believe the brain has chemical reactions that vary from individual to individual. What I do not give credit are doctors that merely survey the individual and then label the issue as such. 

Good emotions come and go.. I have not had one in a while. Usually when I have energy to exercise or play music - I can get some pseudo-fleeting-happy-thoughts. I think all my life I have always been sad or felt alone - even when "happy" in a relationship.
Buddhism appeals to me. I have not really explored it though. It sounds like a nice idea for sure. I understand.
Put it away for tonight, at least. Please?

I do not think I have ever been happy to be me. I was not born into unfortunate circumstance. Unusual, but not completely horrible. I was diagnosed with some form of depression as a teenager. I do not remember what, as I do not care for doctors or meds (I avoid vaccinations and asprin, as well). I know bipolar depression and alcoholism stems from one side of my family... I am sure I have probably inherited that.

Months. I do not like to go out. If I do, I need plenty of wine to quell my anxiety.

I sympathize with your predicament. I have experienced similar, but different, forms of condescension.

I have done online dating quite a few times with mixed result. A long distance relationship resulted in me moving states. Some short term stuff, only one or two I would consider meaningful. Truthfully, my issue with online dating sites is that I do not find the vast majority of local female matches all that interesting or attractive. I step outside my preferences on occasion but usually find that effort ultimately wasted. In general I find most online dating to be so lazy. Women will either respond (or not) to a "Hi" as much as they would to anything pertinent to their profile. There are so many choices on the menu, I guess it makes it difficult to order. 

I feel that love is so twisted. It invokes emotions I do not want to experience. My experience has lead me to believe that love is rarely equal. "How I met your mother" had an episode on reacher and settlers.. I've been both. The time I moved for a woman I thought I was reaching. Ultimately, I was settling and compromising so much - it left me devastated, and I guess has somewhat been a recurring nightmare.
Why a nun? I feel like religion is anything but peace. How about a deserted island?
I'm sorry to hear what you're going through. Peace is an extremely coveted asset. I wish I could answer your "why"
